verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents its own headless mode for running without a UI under external API control, command-line macro execution against files, and batch conversion and printing. A community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates, so background, unattended processing is real. However, there is no built-in way to set up recurring or autonomous automations: scheduling and triggering must come from external tools such as cron or clients, and one user reports the macro developer experience is poor. missing for 10: native scheduler or recurring-trigger setup, autonomous or agentic automation configuration within the product, evidence of a smooth automation authoring experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Starts in "headless mode" which allows using the application without user interface. This special mode can be used when the application is controlled by external clients via the API.
Opens the file and applies specified macros from the file.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
